sj-building-ti.en: San José's standard plan review for a commercial tenant improvement takes about 10 working days for the first round and 5 working days for each recheck.
sj-building-ti.zh: 圣何塞对商业租户装修的标准图纸审查，首轮约需 10 个工作日，每次复审约 5 个工作日。
sj-building-ti.quote: Miscellaneous commercial project 10 5 10 5 10 5 ... *Number of Working Days, Monday-Friday.

sj-fire-systems.en: Fire Department review of fire protection system plans takes about 10 working days for the first round and 5 working days for each recheck on a commercial project.
sj-fire-systems.zh: 消防局对商业项目消防系统图纸的审查，首轮约需 10 个工作日，每次复审约 5 个工作日。
sj-fire-systems.quote: The time frames in the table reflect the typical time required by the Fire Protection Division staff

sj-building-final.en: San José doesn't publish a wait time for the final inspection; you request it on SJPermits.org, and it's approved only after every other inspection on the permit has passed.
sj-building-final.zh: 圣何塞没有公布最终验收的等待时间；需在 SJPermits.org 上预约，且只有在许可证上的其他所有检查都通过后才会批准。
sj-building-final.quote: Building Final will only be approved after all of the other inspection processes associated with the permit

scc-health-permit.en: The county's plan review can take up to 20 business days, and the invoice for the operating permit is sent after the final inspection passes.
scc-health-permit.zh: 县卫生局的图纸审查最长可能需要 20 个工作日；最终检查通过后，县里会寄出营业许可证的缴费通知单。
scc-health-permit.quote: This review may require up to 20 business days and the inspector will either approve or request revisions of your plans.

ca-ftb-3522.en: Paying the $800 LLC tax online through Web Pay is immediate; it's due by the 15th day of the 4th month of the LLC's tax year.
ca-ftb-3522.zh: 通过 Web Pay 在线缴纳 800 美元的 LLC 年税可即时完成；须在 LLC 纳税年度第 4 个月的第 15 天前缴纳。
ca-ftb-3522.quote: Make a payment online using Web Pay for Businesses. LLCs can make an immediate payment or schedule payments up to a year in advance.

ca-prop65.en: Nothing is filed with or approved by OEHHA, so there's no processing time; the business decides whether a warning is needed and must have it in place itself.
ca-prop65.zh: 无需向 OEHHA 提交或申请批准，因此没有办理时间；是否需要警示由企业自行判断并自行张贴。
ca-prop65.quote: Businesses are responsible for determining if a warning is required for their products

sf-formula-retail.en: The affidavit itself isn't reviewed separately, but where neighborhood notification is required, neighbors get 30 days to respond, and districts that need Conditional Use go to a Planning Commission hearing.
sf-formula-retail.zh: 宣誓书本身不单独审查；但如需邻里通知，邻居有 30 天时间回应；需要有条件使用许可的区域还须经规划委员会听证。
sf-formula-retail.quote: they are given a period of 30 days to respond with concerns or to request a Discretionary Review (DR)

sf-dph-plan-check.en: DPH doesn't publish a plan review time, but asks you to contact your plan reviewer at least 2 weeks ahead to book the pre-final and final site inspections.
sf-dph-plan-check.zh: 公共卫生局未公布图纸审查时间，但要求至少提前 2 周联系审图员预约预终检和终检现场检查。
sf-dph-plan-check.quote: Contact your health plan reviewer at least 2 weeks in advance to set up your site inspections.

sf-dph-health-permit.en: Apply for the health permit at least 1 month before you open.
sf-dph-health-permit.zh: 须在开业前至少 1 个月申请卫生许可证。
sf-dph-health-permit.quote: Apply for a Health Permit at least 1 month before you open a: Restaurant Bar Food market Bakery

sf-sign.en: DBI doesn't publish a review time for sign or awning permits; you apply online with construction drawings, and the sign must meet the zoning rules for your district.
sf-sign.zh: 建筑检查局未公布招牌或遮阳篷许可证的审查时间；需在线提交施工图申请，招牌还须符合所在区的分区规定。
sf-sign.quote: You can now apply online for permits to install new signs or awnings.

sf-fire-assembly.en: Fire permit applications must be submitted at least 5 working days before the activity or operation starts.
sf-fire-assembly.zh: 消防许可申请须在活动或经营开始前至少 5 个工作日提交。
sf-fire-assembly.quote: All fire permit applications shall be submitted a minimum of five (5) working days ... prior to the commencing date

lac-health-permit.en: Plan review is completed within 20 working days after payment (10 if you pay for expedited review); the inspector needs at least 3 working days' notice for the final inspection, and the permit is issued after the permit fee is paid.
lac-health-permit.zh: 图纸审查在付款后 20 个工作日内完成（付费加急为 10 个工作日）；最终检查须至少提前 3 个工作日预约，缴纳许可费后即发放许可证。
lac-health-permit.quote: The turn-around time for a plan review is within twenty (20) working days after the receipt of payment.

irv-license.en: Irvine doesn't publish how long it takes to issue the license; the online application takes minutes, and new businesses must apply within 60 days of starting to avoid late fees.
irv-license.zh: 尔湾市未公布营业执照的发放时间；在线申请只需几分钟，新企业须在开业后 60 天内申请，以免产生滞纳金。
irv-license.quote: you can complete your application online in minutes

oc-health-permit.en: Initial plan review usually takes 20 working days; inspections must be requested 5 working days ahead, and the health permit is issued once the final inspection passes.
oc-health-permit.zh: 首次图纸审查通常需要 20 个工作日；检查须提前 5 个工作日预约，最终检查通过后即发放卫生许可证。
oc-health-permit.quote: It usually takes 20 working days for the initial Food Facility plan review.

sdg-co.en: San Diego doesn't publish a delivery time for a commercial Certificate of Occupancy; it's issued once every inspection under the permit has final approval (only affordable housing and shelters get set deadlines).
sdg-co.zh: 圣地亚哥市未公布商业入住许可证的发放时间；许可证项下所有检查获最终批准后即签发（只有经济适用房和紧急庇护所有规定期限）。
sdg-co.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy is issued upon final approval of all inspections for work authorized under a building permit

sdc-health-permit.en: Plans are approved or rejected within 20 working days of receipt, and plan check staff issue the health permit when the facility passes its final inspection.
sdc-health-permit.zh: 图纸在收到后 20 个工作日内予以批准或驳回；设施通过最终检查后，审图人员即发放卫生许可证。
sdc-health-permit.quote: The plans will either be approved or rejected within twenty working days after receipt and the applicant will be notified of the decision.

nyc-co.en: DOB doesn't publish a processing time for a Certificate of Occupancy; staff review the request in DOB NOW: Build and issue the CO once every sign-off and requirement is in.
nyc-co.zh: 纽约市建筑局未公布入住许可证的办理时间；工作人员在 DOB NOW: Build 中审核申请，所有验收和要求齐全后即签发。
nyc-co.quote: The request is reviewed by technical and operations staff and if all requirements are provided, a CO is issued.

ny-dol-100.en: The Department of Labor doesn't publish how long registration takes; it assigns each liable employer an eight-digit employer registration number after you register.
ny-dol-100.zh: 劳工部未公布登记所需时间；登记后会为每个负有缴纳义务的雇主分配一个八位数的雇主登记号。
ny-dol-100.quote: We assign each liable employer an eight-digit employer registration number.

ny-wcb.en: The Board doesn't publish a processing time because coverage is bought from an insurer, but DB/PFL coverage must be in place within four weeks after a new employee's 30th day of work.
ny-wcb.zh: 由于保险需向保险公司购买，委员会未公布办理时间；但残疾及带薪家事假保险须在新员工入职第 30 天后的四周内生效。
ny-wcb.quote: For new employees, DB/PFL coverage must be obtained within four weeks from the newly hired employee's 30th day of employment.

nyc-sign.en: DOB doesn't publish a review time for sign permits; the sign permit is filed in DOB NOW: Build, with a separate electrical permit if the sign is lit.
nyc-sign.zh: 纽约市建筑局未公布招牌许可证的审查时间；招牌许可证在 DOB NOW: Build 中提交，带照明的招牌还需另办电气许可证。
nyc-sign.quote: A Sign permit (SG) must be filed for the copy (text or image) to be displayed. This is filed through DOB NOW: Build .

tx-food-manager.en: DSHS doesn't issue the certificate itself; the accredited exam provider issues it as soon as you pass the exam.
tx-food-manager.zh: 州卫生服务部本身不发证；通过考试后，由认证考试机构当即发放证书。
tx-food-manager.quote: Upon successful completion of the examination, a CFM certificate is issued that is valid in Texas.

tx-food-handler.en: Each food employee must complete an accredited food handler course within 30 days of being hired; the training provider issues the card.
tx-food-handler.zh: 每名食品从业员工须在入职后 30 天内完成经认证的食品处理培训课程，由培训机构发放证卡。
tx-food-handler.quote: all food employees shall successfully complete an accredited food handler training course, within 30 days of employment.

hou-co.en: Houston lists the Certificate of Occupancy's processing time as 15 minutes once the final inspection is approved; the certificate is emailed to you.
hou-co.zh: 休斯顿公布的入住许可证办理时间为 15 分钟（在最终检查通过后）；证书将通过电子邮件发送。

tx-franchise.en: The Comptroller doesn't publish a processing time for the report; the annual franchise tax report is due May 15 (next business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday).
tx-franchise.zh: 州审计长办公室未公布报告的处理时间；年度特许经营税报告须在 5 月 15 日前提交（如逢周末或假日则顺延至下一个工作日）。
tx-franchise.quote: The annual franchise tax report is due May 15.

dal-co.en: Dallas's goal is to review a CO application within 15 business days on average, though its CO page notes processing times differ based on demand.
dal-co.zh: 达拉斯的目标是平均在 15 个工作日内审核入住许可证申请，但其页面也说明办理时间会因申请量而异。
dal-co.quote: Certificate of Occupancy ... Average # of Business Days to review 15 Days

dal-building.en: Dallas's goal for a commercial alteration/addition is an initial plan review within 15 business days and a resubmittal review within 7.
dal-building.zh: 达拉斯对商业改建/扩建项目的目标是：首次图纸审查 15 个工作日内完成，重新提交后的审查 7 个工作日内完成。
dal-building.quote: Average # of Business Days for Initial Review ... Commercial Alteration/Addition 15 Days

dal-plan-review.en: Dallas's goal for the Health team's initial plan review is 15 business days.
dal-plan-review.zh: 达拉斯卫生审图组首次图纸审查的目标时间为 15 个工作日。
dal-plan-review.quote: Health ... Average # of Business Days for Initial Review 15 Days

dal-food-permit.en: Consumer Health doesn't publish a processing time; after you apply, you schedule and coordinate the required health inspections with your permitting inspector.
dal-food-permit.zh: 消费者健康部门未公布办理时间；提交申请后，需自行与许可检查员预约并协调所需的卫生检查。
dal-food-permit.quote: The applicant is responsible for scheduling and coordinating all required health inspections with their permitting inspector after application.

dal-fire-hood.en: Dallas doesn't publish a review time for kitchen hood fire-extinguishing system permits; its published goals cover only fire alarm, sprinkler and flammable-liquid reviews.
dal-fire-hood.zh: 达拉斯未公布厨房排烟罩灭火系统许可证的审查时间；其公布的目标只涵盖火警、喷淋和易燃液体审查。
dal-fire-hood.quote: The Fire Protection Team reviews fire protection systems for compliance with the applicable codes and standards the City of Dallas has adopted.

aus-building.en: Commercial plan review for a remodel up to 25,000 sq ft takes 10 business days; small projects, such as a finish-out under 10,000 sq ft, take 5 business days.
aus-building.zh: 面积不超过 25,000 平方英尺的改建项目，商业图纸审查需 10 个工作日；小型项目（如 10,000 平方英尺以下的内部装修）需 5 个工作日。
aus-building.quote: Remodel ≤ 25,000 sq. ft. - 10 business days ... Small Projects - 5 business days

aus-food-plan-review.en: Inside the City of Austin, the food plan review is submitted with the commercial building application, whose review takes 10 business days for a remodel up to 25,000 sq ft (5 for small projects).
aus-food-plan-review.zh: 在奥斯汀市辖区内，食品图纸审查随商业建筑申请一并提交；面积不超过 25,000 平方英尺的改建项目审查需 10 个工作日（小型项目 5 个工作日）。

aus-food-preopening.en: Austin Public Health doesn't publish how soon a pre-opening inspection happens; you apply once the space is built, and you must pass before the permit is issued.
aus-food-preopening.zh: 奥斯汀公共卫生局未公布开业前检查的排期时间；场所建成后即可申请，通过检查后才会发放许可证。
aus-food-preopening.quote: The facility must pass this inspection before a permit can be issued and the business can operate.

aus-food-permit.en: Austin Public Health doesn't publish a processing time; the operating permit is issued after the pre-opening inspection is approved.
aus-food-permit.zh: 奥斯汀公共卫生局未公布办理时间；开业前检查通过后即发放经营许可证。
aus-food-permit.quote: Operational Permit — issued after the Pre-Opening inspection approval; must be renewed annually.

aus-sign.en: Austin doesn't publish a review time for sign permits; staff review the application once the review fee is paid and email you the decision.
aus-sign.zh: 奥斯汀未公布招牌许可证的审查时间；缴纳审查费后工作人员才开始审查，并通过电子邮件通知结果。
aus-sign.quote: Once the review fee is paid staff will review your application and communicate with you via email if the request is approved or rejected.

ftw-plan-review.en: Fort Worth Consumer Health doesn't publish a plan review time for food establishments.
ftw-plan-review.zh: 沃思堡消费者健康部门未公布食品场所的图纸审查时间。
ftw-plan-review.quote: For these details, call the Consumer Health Division at 817-392-7255.

ftw-co.en: The CO is emailed to the permit contact on the business day after final approval.
ftw-co.zh: 最终验收通过后的下一个工作日，入住许可证会通过电子邮件发送给许可证联系人。
ftw-co.quote: The CO will be e-mailed to the contact person listed for the permit on the business day following the final approval.

ftw-food-permit.en: Contact the inspector at least one week before your expected opening to schedule the inspection; the permit is issued once all requirements are met and fees are paid.
ftw-food-permit.zh: 须在预计开业日期前至少一周联系检查员预约检查；满足所有要求并缴清费用后即发放许可证。
ftw-food-permit.quote: The inspector should be contacted at least one week prior to your expected date of opening to schedule an inspection.

sat-co.en: San Antonio doesn't publish a processing time for a Certificate of Occupancy; for new construction it's issued once all required inspections are complete.
sat-co.zh: 圣安东尼奥未公布入住许可证的办理时间；新建项目在所有规定检查完成后签发。

sat-food.en: Metro Health doesn't publish a processing time; the license is issued only after all building, health and fire inspections are approved and recorded, and you must show a valid CofO to buy the permit.
sat-food.zh: 大都会卫生局未公布办理时间；所有建筑、卫生和消防检查经批准并登记后才会发放执照，购买许可证时须出示有效的入住许可证。
sat-food.quote: A valid CofO must be presented at the time you wish to purchase a food permit.

mc-plan-review.en: Maricopa County recommends applying at least 6 to 8 weeks before construction starts; if you'll finish within 15 business days of submitting, you must pay for expedited review.
mc-plan-review.zh: 马里科帕县建议在施工开始前至少 6 至 8 周提交申请；如预计在提交后 15 个工作日内完工，则须付费申请加急审查。
mc-plan-review.quote: we recommend applying at least 6 to 8 weeks prior to the commencement of construction or remodeling to obtain the proper permits.

phx-co.en: Phoenix issues the Certificate of Occupancy 24 hours after the final inspection and mails it to the owner.
phx-co.zh: 凤凰城在最终检查后 24 小时内签发入住许可证，并邮寄给业主。
phx-co.quote: The Certificate of Occupancy or the Certificate of Completion will be issued 24 hours after the final inspection.

mc-food-permit.en: After you apply, expect an email with your permit number and payment instructions within 2 business days; the permit itself follows plan review, inspection and fee payment.
mc-food-permit.zh: 提交申请后，通常 2 个工作日内会收到含许可证编号和缴费说明的电子邮件；许可证本身还需经过图纸审查、检查和缴费后才会发放。
mc-food-permit.quote: Please check your Junk or Spam email folders if you do not see an email from us within 2 business days.

fl-dor.en: If you register online, you can return to the website to get your certificate number after three business days.
fl-dor.zh: 在线登记后，三个工作日后即可返回网站获取登记证号码。
fl-dor.quote: You will be able to return to the website to retrieve your certificate number(s) after three business days.

tpa-business-tax.en: Tampa doesn't publish a processing time for a new business tax receipt; applications are made online or by appointment.
tpa-business-tax.zh: 坦帕市未公布新营业税收据的办理时间；可在线申请或预约办理。
tpa-business-tax.quote: Appointments Required, please call 813-274-8751 for an appointment.

fl-dbpr.en: Most license applications are processed within a few business days (longer by mail); new licenses also need an opening inspection, which you should request several business days before opening.
fl-dbpr.zh: 大多数执照申请在几个工作日内处理完毕（邮寄申请更久）；新执照还需开业检查，应在开业前几个工作日预约。
fl-dbpr.quote: Most applications are processed within a few business days once we receive them, please allow additional time if submitting by mail.

ocfl-business-tax.en: Orange County doesn't publish a processing time; Zoning must approve the business (and a CO is needed for new or altered space) before the Tax Collector issues the receipt.
ocfl-business-tax.zh: 奥兰治县未公布办理时间；须先获分区部门批准（新建或改建场所还需入住许可证），税务征收官才会发放营业税收据。
ocfl-business-tax.quote: The Orange County Zoning Division must approve all proposed new businesses located within Unincorporated Orange County.

mia-btr.en: Business tax receipts are printed weekly and mailed within three business days after printing.
mia-btr.zh: 营业税收据每周打印一次，打印后三个工作日内寄出。
mia-btr.quote: Business Tax Receipts are printed weekly and are mailed within three business days thereafter.

wa-bls.en: Online applications take about 10 business days to process; city or state endorsements can add another 2–3 weeks.
wa-bls.zh: 在线申请约需 10 个工作日处理；如涉及市级或州级附加许可，可能还需额外 2 至 3 周。
wa-bls.quote: Apply online applications will take approximately 10 business days to process.

sea-food.en: An initial plan review can take up to 8–10 weeks at current volumes; book the pre-operational inspection at least 1 week before opening.
sea-food.zh: 按目前的申请量，首次图纸审查可能需要 8 至 10 周；开业前检查须至少提前 1 周预约。
sea-food.quote: Due to current application volumes, it may take up to 8-10 weeks for a Plan Reviewer to complete an initial review.

il-tax.en: Registration through MyTax Illinois takes about one to two business days to process; paper applications take four to six weeks.
il-tax.zh: 通过 MyTax Illinois 在线登记约需一至两个工作日处理；纸质申请需四至六周。
il-tax.quote: processing time for a registration application submitted through MyTax Illinois is approximately one to two business days.

chi-license.en: Chicago doesn't publish a standard processing time; the license is issued after zoning approval, payment and any required inspections, then mailed to your business.
chi-license.zh: 芝加哥未公布标准办理时间；执照须经分区审批、缴费及所需检查后签发，并邮寄到营业地址。
chi-license.quote: Once all inspections are passed in step 6 and holds resolved in step 7, the license will be mailed to your business address.

ma-tax.en: DOR doesn't publish how long registration takes; once approved, it mails a registration certificate for each location.
ma-tax.zh: 税务局未公布登记所需时间；批准后会为每个营业地点邮寄一份登记证。
ma-tax.quote: Once approved, DOR will mail you a certificate for each location you have

bos-cert.en: The City Clerk issues a business certificate while you wait in person, or in 2–3 days by mail.
bos-cert.zh: 现场办理时市书记官处可当场发放营业证书，邮寄办理需 2 至 3 天。
bos-cert.quote: Timeline: While you wait in person, or 2-3 days by mail.

ga-tax.en: After registering online in the Georgia Tax Center, you should get your tax account number by email within 15 minutes.
ga-tax.zh: 通过 Georgia Tax Center 在线登记后，通常 15 分钟内即可通过电子邮件收到税号。
ga-tax.quote: After your online submission, you should receive your specific tax account number within 15 minutes by email.

atl-license.en: Atlanta doesn't publish how long a new business license takes; only the zoning review step is done the same day when you apply in person, and some applications need additional days.
atl-license.zh: 亚特兰大未公布新营业执照的办理时间；仅分区审查一步在现场申请时可当天完成，部分申请需额外数日。
atl-license.quote: processed on the same day if you are submitting your business license application in person.

pa-tax.en: The Department of Revenue doesn't publish how long myPATH registration takes to issue a sales tax license.
pa-tax.zh: 宾州税务局未公布通过 myPATH 登记后签发销售税执照所需的时间。

phl-cal.en: Applied for online through eCLIPSE, the Commercial Activity License is issued automatically; in person, it's issued while you wait.
phl-cal.zh: 通过 eCLIPSE 在线申请，商业活动执照会自动签发；现场办理则可当场取得。

lv-license.en: A license technician emails you within 5 business days of an online application, and the license is issued within 30 days of applying, often much sooner.
lv-license.zh: 在线申请后，执照专员会在 5 个工作日内发邮件联系您；执照在申请后 30 天内签发，通常会快得多。
lv-license.quote: expect your license to be issued within 30 days of applying.

lv-food.en: The Health District doesn't publish a plan review or permit time; applications go through the EH Portal and are processed in the order received.
lv-food.zh: 卫生区未公布图纸审查或许可证的办理时间；申请须通过 EH Portal 提交，并按收件顺序处理。
lv-food.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically via the EH Portal and will be processed in the order in which they are received.

dc-dlcp.en: DLCP doesn't publish how long a Basic Business License takes; you need a processed FR-500 tax registration and a Clean Hands check before you can apply.
dc-dlcp.zh: 消费者保护与许可局未公布基本营业执照的办理时间；申请前须先完成 FR-500 税务登记并通过 Clean Hands 审查。
dc-dlcp.quote: A Clean Hands check will be conducted during the Basic Business License online application process.

dc-otr.en: The Office of Tax and Revenue may take up to 10 business days to process an FR-500 registration.
dc-otr.zh: 税收办公室处理 FR-500 登记最长可能需要 10 个工作日。
dc-otr.quote: the DC Office of Tax and Revenue may take up to 10 business days to process your registration.

dc-food.en: DC Health doesn't publish a plan review or licensing time; plans go through ProjectDox with the building permit, and you need a passed pre-operational inspection before the license.
dc-food.zh: 华盛顿特区卫生局未公布图纸审查或执照办理时间；图纸随建筑许可证通过 ProjectDox 提交，须通过开业前检查后才能取得执照。
dc-food.quote: A building permit applicant shall submit to the Division, via DCRA ProjectDOX, properly prepared plans, specifications and menu(s) for review and approval
